event.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Will Smith homered in the 11th inning after Miguel Rojas connected for a tying drive in the ninth, and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Toronto Blue Jays 5-4 in Game 7 Saturday night to become the first team in a quarter century to win consecutive...
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith's homer in 11th lifts Dodgers over Blue Jays 5-4 to become first repeat champion in 25 years
